#### Default path (no `--review`): inline deterministic validation

Write the following Node.js script to `$UA_DIR/tmp/ua-inline-validate.cjs`:

```javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node
const fs = require('fs');
const graphPath = process.argv[2];
const outputPath = process.argv[3];
try {
  const graph = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(graphPath, 'utf8'));
  const issues = [], warnings = [];
  if (!Array.isArray(graph.nodes)) { issues.push('graph.nodes is missing or not an array'); graph.nodes = []; }
  if (!Array.isArray(graph.edges)) { issues.push('graph.edges is missing or not an array'); graph.edges = []; }
  const nodeIds = new Set();
  const seen = new Map();
  graph.nodes.forEach((n, i) => {
    if (!n.id) { issues.push(`Node[${i}] missing id`); return; }
    if (!n.type) issues.push(`Node[${i}] '${n.id}' missing type`);
    if (!n.name) issues.push(`Node[${i}] '${n.id}' missing name`);
    if (!n.summary) issues.push(`Node[${i}] '${n.id}' missing summary`);
    if (!n.tags || !n.tags.length) issues.push(`Node[${i}] '${n.id}' missing tags`);
    if (seen.has(n.id)) issues.push(`Duplicate node ID '${n.id}' at indices ${seen.get(n.id)} and ${i}`);
    else seen.set(n.id, i);
    nodeIds.add(n.id);
  });
  graph.edges.forEach((e, i) => {
    if (!nodeIds.has(e.source)) issues.push(`Edge[${i}] source '${e.source}' not found`);
    if (!nodeIds.has(e.target)) issues.push(`Edge[${i}] target '${e.target}' not found`);
  });
  const fileLevelTypes = new Set(['file', 'config', 'document', 'service', 'pipeline', 'table', 'schema', 'resource', 'endpoint']);
  const fileNodes = graph.nodes.filter(n => fileLevelTypes.has(n.type)).map(n => n.id);
  const assigned = new Map();
  if (!Array.isArray(graph.layers)) { if (graph.layers) warnings.push('graph.layers is not an array'); graph.layers = []; }
  if (!Array.isArray(graph.tour)) { if (graph.tour) warnings.push('graph.tour is not an array'); graph.tour = []; }
  graph.layers.forEach(layer => {
    (layer.nodeIds || []).forEach(id => {
      if (!nodeIds.has(id)) issues.push(`Layer '${layer.id}' refs missing node '${id}'`);
      if (assigned.has(id)) issues.push(`Node '${id}' appears in multiple layers`);
      assigned.set(id, layer.id);
    });
  });
  fileNodes.forEach(id => {
    if (!assigned.has(id)) issues.push(`File node '${id}' not in any layer`);
  });
  graph.tour.forEach((step, i) => {
    (step.nodeIds || []).forEach(id => {
      if (!nodeIds.has(id)) issues.push(`Tour step[${i}] refs missing node '${id}'`);
    });
  });
  const withEdges = new Set([
    ...graph.edges.map(e => e.source),
    ...graph.edges.map(e => e.target)
  ]);
  graph.nodes.forEach(n => {
    if (!withEdges.has(n.id)) warnings.push(`Node '${n.id}' has no edges (orphan)`);
  });
  const stats = {
    totalNodes: graph.nodes.length,
    totalEdges: graph.edges.length,
    totalLayers: graph.layers.length,
    tourSteps: graph.tour.length,
    nodeTypes: graph.nodes.reduce((a, n) => { a[n.type] = (a[n.type]||0)+1; return a; }, {}),
    edgeTypes: graph.edges.reduce((a, e) => { a[e.type] = (a[e.type]||0)+1; return a; }, {})
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, JSON.stringify({ issues, warnings, stats }, null, 2));
  process.exit(0);
} catch (err) { process.stderr.write(err.message + '\n'); process.exit(1); }
```

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - This session continued from a prior compacted conversation where Tasks 11 and 12 of `.agents/plans/2026-07-22-spec-audit-remediation.md` (a rigorous, RED→GREEN→REFACTOR-disciplined implementation plan for the `sea-rs` Rust workspace / SEA Forge) had already been completed, tested, and documented.

   - Task 13 (verbatim goal): "Make Thoth claim derivation bounded and total (M11 library · critical)" — Every typed question has a bounded handler, emitted claims never exceed permitted classes/evidence, and a required-fresh policy refuses stale snapshots before query execution.
   - Task 13B (verbatim goal): "Enforce immutable Thoth authorship at settlement and promotion (M11 SoD · critical)" — Every Thoth-authored claim carries immutable provenance, and the same actor cannot declare its settlement or promote its capability through copied or replayed records.
   - Global constraints carried forward from the plan (established in prior session, still binding): RED→GREEN→REFACTOR discipline; every task ends with a verification gate that must exit 0; never weaken/rename/delete a failing conformance test; no new persisted schema/public interface changes without explicit approval (ADR-002/ADR-003 pre-approve specific deltas for these exact tasks); keep kernel crates synchronous; don't hand-edit generated zones or commit `.sea-forge/**` runtime output.
   - No instruction to commit has been given at any point in this session — per my own operating rules, commits only happen when explicitly requested.
   - No security-sensitive files, secrets, destructive operations, or special data-handling constraints were referenced by the user in this session.
   - The project's `CLAUDE.md` mandates context-mode MCP tool routing (`ctx_execute`, `ctx_execute_file`, `ctx_batch_execute`) for analysis/exploration to protect context window size, while `Read`/`Edit` remain correct for files being directly edited — I followed this distinction throughout (using `ctx_execute_file`/`ctx_execute` for grepping the plan/ADR docs, and `Read`+`Edit`/`Write` for all files I actually modified).

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Rust workspace with ~20+ `sea-forge-*` crates; kernel/domain crates stay synchronous (no tokio/HTTP outside `sea-forge-server`/`sea-forge-agent`).
   - `sea-forge-thoth` crate structure: `protocol.rs` (289 lines, the typed claim/question/answer vocabulary — `ClaimStatus` totem-pole ordering `Unknown < Unsupported < Declared < Installed < Available < Validated < Demonstrated`; `ClaimClass` 12 variants with `is_high_risk()` flagging the last 4; `GroundedClaim` with `authored_by: Option<String>`; `QuestionKind` 9 variants; `candidate_classes(kind)` total compile-time mapping; `DisclosurePlan`, `Disposition`, `Freshness`, `ThothAnswer`), `engine.rs` (the file rewritten for Task 13/13B — `SnapshotView` trait, `DisclosurePolicy` trait, `answer_question`, `derive_claims`), `manager.rs` (unrelated `ManagerView`/`judge` logic, untouched), `lib.rs` (re-exports).
   - **Bounded, never-elevate capping principle** (Task 13's core fix): a claim's disclosed `claim_class` must always be a member of `permitted`; its `status` must never exceed the evidence rung that class allows. Implemented via `capped_capability_claim`: uses the natural class (derived from actual `cap.status`) when that class is itself permitted; otherwise downgrades to the highest permitted class strictly below it, capping `status` to that class's ceiling (`DeclaredCapability→Declared`, `InstalledCapability→Available`, `DemonstratedCapability→Demonstrated`).
   - **Totality principle** (Task 13): every `QuestionKind` (all 9) must produce a deterministic typed outcome; `Answered` disposition must never carry an unexplained empty claim set. Achieved by giving every previously-unhandled kind (`AskOperationRequirements`, `AskAuthorityRequirements`, `AskFailureExplanation`, `AskEvidenceForClaim`) a bounded handler that always emits either a real claim or a typed `Unsupported`-status claim.
   - **Pre-query freshness gate** (Task 13 step 5): `answer_question` now checks `policy.requires_fresh() && snapshot.is_stale()` BEFORE calling `derive_claims`, returning `Denied` immediately — critically, this only ever calls `snapshot.is_stale()`/`snapshot.snapshot_ref()` (metadata methods), never the content-bearing bounded query methods (`capability`, `declared_capabilities`, `environment_status`). pub fn evaluate(
        &self,
        input: AuthorityEvaluation<'_>,
    ) -> Result<AuthorityDecision, ForgeError> {
        self.evaluate_at(input, random_id("act")?, Utc::now().to_rfc3339())
    }

    pub fn grant(
        &self,
        decision: &AuthorityDecision,
        committed: &CommittedRecordRef,
        action: &AuthorityAction,
        assurance: Option<&PreActionAssurance>,
    ) -> Result<ActionGrant, ForgeError> {
        self.grant_exact(
            decision,
            committed,
            action,
            assurance,
            Verdict::Allow,
            decision.sandbox_class_granted.clone(),
            None,
        )
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn grant_after_approval(
        &self,
        decision: &AuthorityDecision,
        committed_decision: &CommittedRecordRef,
        action: &AuthorityAction,
        approval: &ApprovalRequest,
        committed_approval: &CommittedRecordRef,
        criteria: &SettlementCriteriaRecord,
        committed_criteria: &CommittedRecordRef,
        assurance: Option<&PreActionAssurance>,
        stream: &LedgerStream,

        self.grant_after_approval_inner(
            decision,
            committed_decision,
            action,
            approval,
            committed_approval,
            criteria,
            committed_criteria,
            assurance,
            stream,
            false,
        )
    }

    /// Idempotent variant for resume retries: when the approval was already
    /// consumed by a prior grant (e.g. a parked resume that minted the grant
    /// but could not complete the side effect), re-derive the same grant

            committed_decision,
            action,
            approval,
            committed_approval,
            criteria,
            committed_criteria,
            assurance,
            stream,
            true,
        )
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn grant_after_approval_inner(
        &self,
        decision: &AuthorityDecision,
        committed_decision: &CommittedRecordRef,
        action: &AuthorityAction,
        approval: &ApprovalRequest,
        committed_approval: &CommittedRecordRef,
        criteria: &SettlementCriteriaRecord,
        committed_criteria: &CommittedRecordRef,
        assurance: Option<&PreActionAssurance>,
        stream: &LedgerStream,
        idempotent: bool,
    ) -> Result<ActionGrant, ForgeError> {
        if decision.verdict != Verdict::Escalate
            || decision.normalized_disposition != NormalizedDisposition::Escalate
            || committed_decision.record_kind() != "authority_decision"
            || committed_approval.record_kind() != "approval_resolution"
            || committed_criteria.record_kind() != "settlement_criteria"
            || committed_decision.ledger_id() != committed_approval.ledger_id()
            || committed_decision.ledger_id() != committed_criteria.ledger_id()
        {
            return Err(ForgeError::Input(
                "approval grant requires exact records from one ledger".into(),
            ));
        }
        if committed_approval.payload_hash() != payload_hash(&serde_json::to_value(approval)?)?
            || committed_criteria.payload_hash() != payload_hash(&serde_json::to_value(criteria)?)?
        {
            return Err(ForgeError::Input(
                "approval or criteria record is not bound to its committed payload".into(),
            ));
        }
        let case_id =
            decision.audit_record.case_id.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
                ForgeError::Input("authority decision has no case context".into())
            })?;
        let requester = decision
            .action_request
            .actor
            .get("actor_id")
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .ok_or_else(|| ForgeError::Input("authority requester is malformed".into()))?;
        if approval.status != ApprovalStatus::Approved
            || approval.decision_id != decision.decision_id
            || approval.case_id != case_id
            || approval.run_id != decision.run_id
            || approval.plan_item_id != decision.plan_item_id
            || approval.criteria_ref.as_deref() != Some(criteria.criteria_id.as_str())

45	## Established compatibility convention (already in production, not new)

48	
49	1. **New optional struct field**: `#[serde(default)]` +

171	bump is reserved for breaking changes per the existing convention (item 4

174	milestones.

163	        capability::memory::MemoryRecallQuery {
164	            query,
165	            entity_id: query_entity_filter,
166	            process_id: process,
167	            kinds,
168	            limit,
169	        },
170	    )?;
171	    let scoped_results: Vec<_> = results
172	        .into_iter()
173	        .filter(|item| {
174	            sea_forge_authority::scope_allows(&memory_scope, actor_id, &item.attribution.entity_id)
175	        })
176	        .collect();
177	
178	    let memory_ids: Vec<&str> = scoped_results
179	        .iter()
180	        .map(|i| i.memory_id.as_str())
181	        .collect();
182	    let assurance = super::mediated::assurance(root, &policy_path, actor_id)?;
183	    commit_recall_evidence(
184	        root,
185	        actor_id,
186	        &memory_scope,
187	        &assurance,
188	        entity,
189	        process,
190	        kind,
191	        limit,
192	        &memory_ids,
193	    )?;
194	    tracing::info!(
195	        event = "recall_evidence_committed",
196	        component = "sea-forge-cli::recall",
197	        requester_entity = actor_id,
198	        memory_scope = %memory_scope,
199	        assurance = %assurance,
200	        returned = memory_ids.len(),
201	    );
202	
203	    for item in &scoped_results {
204	        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string(item)?);
205	    }
206	    Ok(if scoped_results.is_empty() { 3 } else { 0 })
207	}

1	//! Self-model persistence and lifecycle (spec-adlc-thoth §3.1, §7.1, §8.5,
2	//! slice 1.0 + 1.5).
3	//!
4	//! Layout under `<root>/.sea-forge/self-model/`:
5	//!   manifest.json                     — installation manifest (release, current
6	//!                                        snapshot id, staleness); the lifecycle
7	//!                                        discriminator, never an immutable record.
8	//!   realization/release.json          — release realization (verified, not regenerated).
9	//!   realization/cell.json             — cell realization (rebuildable).
10	//!   snapshots/<snapshot_id>.json      — immutable SelfModelSnapshot records.
11	//!   projections/<kind>/...            — rebuildable KG/CALM/JSON projections.
12	//!
13	//! Init/upgrade is detected by the manifest's release_id/schema_version. Upgrade
14	//! never rewrites prior snapshots. Extension mutations mark the current snapshot
15	//! stale via the manifest and request a rebuild; immutable snapshot files are
16	//! never mutated. A failed rebuild preserves the prior verifiable snapshot.

140	/// Construct a well-formed `AuthorityDecision` for a self-model rebuild.
141	///
142	/// ponytail: self-model rebuild is an always-available local lifecycle
143	/// operation over installation state the operator already controls (bundled
144	/// models, the local extension registry, local probes) — unlike case/run
145	/// operations it is never gated by an operator-authored policy surface in the
146	/// spec. Rather than route through `sea_forge_authority::PolicyAuthorityEngine`
147	/// (which requires a YAML policy bundle and is designed for external-risk
148	/// operations like executing commands or agent tasks), this builds a real,
149	/// hash-linked, ledgered `AuthorityDecision` directly: same type, same
150	/// verifiability, no invented policy-file requirement for a bookkeeping
151	/// operation the spec never gates. If self-model rebuild ever needs to be
152	/// denyable, route this through the authority crate instead of adding a
153	/// second decision shape.
154	fn build_rebuild_decision(
155	    actor_id: &str,
156	    cell_id: &str,
157	    snapshot_id: &str,
158	    decided_at: &str,
159	) -> Result<AuthorityDecision, ForgeError> {
160	    let operation = AuthorityAction::Reserved {
161	        resource_type: "self_model_rebuild".into(),
162	        resource_id: cell_id.into(),
163	        parameters: serde_json::json!({"snapshot_id": snapshot_id}),
164	    };
165	    let identity_binding = IdentityBinding {
166	        identity_id: None,
167	        principal: actor_id.into(),
168	        roles: vec![ActorRole::Operator],
169	        actor_type: ActorType::System,
170	        binding_resolution: BindingResolution::LocalDefault,
171	        identity_binding_source: "self_model_lifecycle".into(),
172	        source: None,
173	        sponsor: None,
174	        issued_at: None,
175	        expires_at: None,
176	        identity_binding_hash: None,
177	    };
178	    let action_id = ids::random_id("act")?;
179	    let action_request = AuthorityRequest {
180	        schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION.into(),
181	        action_id: action_id.clone(),
182	        correlation_id: snapshot_id.into(),
183	        timestamp_utc: decided_at.into(),
184	        actor: serde_json::json!({"actor_id": actor_id, "role": "operator"}),
185	        action: serde_json::to_value(&operation)?,
186	        context: serde_json::json!({"cell_id": cell_id, "snapshot_id": snapshot_id}),
187	        evidence: serde_json::json!({}),
188	    };
189	    let determinism = Determinism {
190	        policy_bundle_hash: "self_model.builtin".into(),
191	        action_request_hash: crate::canonical_sha256(&action_request)?,
192	        identity_binding_hash: crate::canonical_sha256(&identity_binding)?,
193	    };
194	    let audit_record = AuditRecord {
195	        engine: "sea-forge-self-model".into(),
196	        disposition: "allow".into(),
197	        subject: format!("self_model_rebuild:{cell_id}"),
198	        reason: "self_model_rebuild_lifecycle_operation".into(),
199	        evidence_refs: vec![],
200	        recorded_at: decided_at.into(),
201	        decision_id: None,
202	        case_id: None,
203	        run_id: None,
204	        policy_bundle_hash: None,
205	        action_request_hash: None,
206	        identity_binding_hash: None,
207	    };
208	    Ok(AuthorityDecision {
209	        version: KERNEL_VERSION.into(),
210	        decision_id: ids::random_id("dec")?,
211	        run_id: snapshot_id.into(),
212	        plan_item_id: "self_model_rebuild".into(),
213	        action_id,
214	        correlation_id: snapshot_id.into(),
215	        operation,
216	        outcome: Verdict::Allow,
217	        verdict: Verdict::Allow,
218	        normalized_disposition: NormalizedDisposition::Allow,
219	        matched_rule: None,
220	        reason_codes: vec!["self_model_lifecycle".into()],
221	        reason: "self-model rebuild is an always-available local lifecycle operation".into(),
222	        policy_refs: vec![],
223	        required_next_steps: vec![],
224	        identity_binding,
225	        determinism,
226	        action_request,
227	        audit_record,
228	        decided_at: decided_at.into(),
229	        candidate_verdicts: vec![],
230	        winning_source: None,
231	        precedence_reason: None,
232	        sandbox_class_granted: None,
233	        approval_request_id: None,
234	        opaque_constraint_id: None,
235	        boundary_constraints: Default::default(),
236	        compensating_controls: vec![],
237	    })
238	}

241	    let path = manifest_path(root);

251	fn write_manifest(root: &Path, manifest: &SelfModelManifest) -> Result<(), ForgeError> {
252	    let path = manifest_path(root);
253	    fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new(".")))
254	        .map_err(|e| ForgeError::io("create self-model dir", e))?;
255	    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(manifest)?;
256	    let tmp = path.with_extension("tmp");
257	    fs::write(&tmp, &bytes).map_err(|e| ForgeError::io("write manifest tmp", e))?;
258	    fs::rename(&tmp, &path).map_err(|e| ForgeError::io("rename manifest", e))?;
259	    Ok(())
260	}

287	/// Ledger the projection records + materialize their view files. Each
288	/// `ProjectionRecord` is committed under `self_model_projection` (spec-adlc-thoth
289	/// §10.1: "Persisted ONLY under the `self_model_projection` ledger record_kind"),
290	/// then its own record and output bytes are materialized as rebuildable views.
291	fn materialize_projections(
292	    root: &Path,
293	    stream: &LedgerStream,
294	    projections: &[SelfModelProjection],
295	) -> Result<(), ForgeError> {
296	    let pdir = projections_dir(root);
297	    // Clear prior projection outputs so a wrong-hash pre-generated file is
298	    // regenerated, not trusted (spec §10.1, T9.3).
299	    if pdir.exists() {
300	        fs::remove_dir_all(&pdir).map_err(|e| ForgeError::io("clear projections dir", e))?;
301	    }
302	    fs::create_dir_all(&pdir).map_err(|e| ForgeError::io("create projections dir", e))?;
303	    for proj in projections {
304	        let kind_label = match proj.record.projection_kind {
305	            sea_forge_core::types::ProjectionKind::Kg => "kg",
306	            sea_forge_core::types::ProjectionKind::Calm => "calm",
307	            sea_forge_core::types::ProjectionKind::SelfModelSnapshot => "self_model_snapshot",
308	            _ => continue,
309	        };
310	        let kind_dir = pdir.join(kind_label);
311	        for (path, content) in &proj.outputs {
312	            let full = pdir.join(path);
313	            stream.materialize_view(
314	                &stream.commit_typed(
315	                    "self_model_projection_output",
316	                    vec![proj.record.projection_id.clone()],
317	                    content,
318	                    proj.record.authority_refs.clone(),
319	                )?,
320	                &full,
321	                content.as_bytes(),
322	            )?;
323	        }
324	        let record_committed = stream.commit_typed(
325	            "self_model_projection",
326	            vec![proj.record.projection_id.clone()],
327	            &proj.record,
328	            proj.record.authority_refs.clone(),
329	        )?;
330	        stream.materialize_view(
331	            &record_committed,
332	            &kind_dir.join("projection-record.json"),
333	            &serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&proj.record)?,
334	        )?;
335	    }
336	    Ok(())
337	}

339	fn assemble(
340	    inputs: &RebuildInputs<'_>,
341	) -> Result<(ComposedModel, SelfModelSnapshot, CellRealization), ForgeError> {
342	    let models = bundled();
343	    verify_bundled(&models)?;
344	    let composed = load_composed(&models)?;
345	    let release = release_realization();
346	    let cell = build_cell_realization(
347	        inputs.cell_id,
348	        inputs.active_extensions.clone(),
349	        inputs.environments_present.clone(),
350	        inputs.probes.clone(),
351	        inputs.sandbox_classes_available.clone(),
352	        inputs.created_at,
353	    );
354	    let snapshot = build_snapshot(
355	        &composed,
356	        &release,
357	        &cell,
358	        inputs.capability_projection_sha256,
359	        inputs.created_at,
360	    )?;
361	    Ok((composed, snapshot, cell))
362	}

364	/// Build a fresh snapshot and commit it: assembles the pure snapshot/cell from
365	/// verified sources, commits validation evidence, an authority decision, and a
366	/// settlement to the self-model ledger stream, threads those governance refs
367	/// into every `ProjectionRecord`, then materializes all views. On any failure
368	/// the prior snapshot remains verifiable (failure atomicity) — nothing is
369	/// written until the snapshot has been built and independently re-verified.
370	pub fn rebuild(root: &Path, inputs: &RebuildInputs<'_>) -> Result<SelfModelSnapshot, ForgeError> {
371	    fs::create_dir_all(snapshots_dir(root))
372	        .map_err(|e| ForgeError::io("create snapshots dir", e))?;
373	    let (composed, snapshot, cell) = assemble(inputs)?;
374	    // Integrity gate before any commit: a snapshot that fails to re-verify its
375	    // own hash is never ledgered or settled accepted.
376	    verify_snapshot(&snapshot)?;
377	
378	    let stream = LedgerStream::open(&root.join(".sea-forge"), LEDGER_STREAM, inputs.actor_id)?;
379	
380	    let evidence = build_verification_evidence(inputs, &snapshot);
381	    let evidence_committed = stream.commit_typed(
382	        "self_model_verification_evidence",
383	        vec![snapshot.snapshot_id.clone()],
384	        &evidence,
385	        vec![],
386	    )?;
387	
388	    let decision = build_rebuild_decision(
389	        inputs.actor_id,
390	        inputs.cell_id,
391	        &snapshot.snapshot_id,
392	        inputs.created_at,
393	    )?;
394	    let authority_committed = stream.commit_typed(
395	        "authority_decision",
396	        vec![snapshot.snapshot_id.clone()],
397	        &decision,
398	        vec![evidence_committed.entry_ulid().to_string()],
399	    )?;
400	
401	    let settlement = SettlementEvent {
402	        version: KERNEL_VERSION.into(),
403	        settlement_id: ids::random_id("set")?,
404	        run_id: snapshot.snapshot_id.clone(),
405	        status: SettlementStatus::Accepted,
406	        basis: vec!["self_model_snapshot_verified".into()],
407	        review_required: false,
408	        settled_at: inputs.created_at.to_string(),
409	        criteria_ref: None,
410	    };
411	    let settlement_committed = stream.commit_typed(
412	        "settlement_event",
413	        vec![snapshot.snapshot_id.clone()],
414	        &settlement,
415	        vec![authority_committed.entry_ulid().to_string()],
416	    )?;
417	
418	    let authority_refs = vec![authority_committed.entry_ulid().to_string()];
419	    let evidence_refs = vec![evidence_committed.entry_ulid().to_string()];
420	    let settlement_ref = Some(settlement_committed.entry_ulid().to_string());
421	
422	    let projections = project_self(
423	        &composed,
424	        &snapshot,
425	        inputs.created_at,
426	        authority_refs.clone(),
427	        evidence_refs,
428	        settlement_ref,
429	    )?;
430	
431	    // Commit order: projections, then release/cell realization, then the
432	    // immutable snapshot, then the manifest pointer. A failure before the
433	    // manifest write leaves the prior current snapshot authoritative.
434	    materialize_projections(root, &stream, &projections)?;
435	
436	    let release = release_realization();
437	    let release_committed = stream.commit_typed_once(
438	        "self_model_release_realization",
439	        release.release_id.clone(),
440	        vec![],
441	        &release,
442	        vec![],
443	    )?;
444	    stream.materialize_view(
445	        &release_committed,
446	        &realization_dir(root).join("release.json"),
447	        &serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&release)?,
448	    )?;
449	
450	    let cell_committed = stream.commit_typed(
451	        "self_model_cell_realization",
452	        vec![snapshot.snapshot_id.clone()],
453	        &cell,
454	        authority_refs.clone(),
455	    )?;
456	    stream.materialize_view(
457	        &cell_committed,
458	        &realization_dir(root).join("cell.json"),
459	        &serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&cell)?,
460	    )?;
461	
462	    let snapshot_committed = stream.commit_typed_new(
463	        "self_model_snapshot",
464	        snapshot.snapshot_id.clone(),
465	        vec![snapshot.snapshot_id.clone()],
466	        &snapshot,
467	        authority_refs,
468	    )?;
469	    stream.materialize_view(
470	        &snapshot_committed,
471	        &snapshot_path(root, &snapshot.snapshot_id),
472	        &serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&snapshot)?,
473	    )?;
474	
475	    let manifest = SelfModelManifest {
476	        schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION.into(),
477	        release_id: RELEASE_ID.into(),
478	        kernel_version: KERNEL_VERSION.into(),
479	        current_snapshot_id: Some(snapshot.snapshot_id.clone()),
480	        stale: false,
481	        stale_reason: None,
482	        initialized_at: inputs.created_at.to_string(),
483	    };
484	    write_manifest(root, &manifest)?;
485	    Ok(snapshot)
486	}

488	/// First-root initialization: if no manifest exists, build the initial snapshot.
489	/// If a manifest exists for the same release, return the current snapshot. A
490	/// release-id change is an upgrade (builds a new snapshot; prior ones remain).
491	pub fn ensure_init(
492	    root: &Path,

1	# ADR-002: Dependency choices for the four-spec audit remediation plan
2	
3	## Status
4	
5	Accepted
6	
7	## Date
8	
9	2026-07-22
10	
11	## Context
12	
13	`.agents/plans/2026-07-22-spec-audit-remediation.md` Task 0 requires exact,
14	research-backed dependency versions/features before any downstream task adds
15	code, per the repository rule that no task may guess a dependency. Three gaps
16	required new or upgraded dependencies:
17	
18	1. **Task 7 (M4b)** — the memory index must become a rebuildable SQLite FTS
19	   projection (`spec-adlc-thoth-minimum.md` explicitly selects SQLite FTS; no
20	   crate is in the workspace today).
21	2. **Task 3 (M1)** — the jail backend must enforce default network denial;
22	   `crates/sea-forge-sandbox/Cargo.toml` currently pins
23	   `landlock = "0.3"` (resolved `0.3.1`) and `jail.rs` hardcodes `ABI::V1`,
24	   which predates Landlock's network-restriction ABI entirely.
25	3. **Task 16 (M13)** — `spec-agent-orchestration.md` §0 "Resolved decisions"
26	   (owner-accepted 2026-07-17) requires a sealed, encrypted canonical
27	   transcript for summarized-mode retention, verified before crypto-shredding.
28	   §6.3 states explicitly: *"This spec selects neither package nor version.
29	   Adding a dependency... requires a later owner approval of the exact
30	   versions and features."* No crypto/AEAD crate exists in the workspace
31	   today; `sha2` (hashing only) and `ed25519-dalek` (signing only) do not
32	   cover symmetric sealing.
33	
34	Every version below was confirmed against live sources on 2026-07-22 (Context7
35	docs mirrors and the crates.io API — not training-data recall, per operator
36	instruction), because prior knowledge of Rust crate versions is not
37	trustworthy for a repository rule that requires exact current versions.
38	
39	## Decision
40	
41	### 1. `rusqlite` for the M4b memory-index FTS projection
42	
43	Add to `crates/sea-forge-capability/Cargo.toml`:
44	
45	```toml
46	rusqlite = { version = "0.32", features = ["bundled"] }
47	```
48	
49	**Post-approval build regression, discovered during Task 7 implementation
50	(2026-07-22):** the originally approved `0.40` (→ `libsqlite3-sys 0.38.1`)
51	fails to compile on this repository's pinned `rustc 1.92.0` (`rust-toolchain.toml`).
52	`libsqlite3-sys-0.38.1/build.rs:110` unconditionally invokes the still-unstable
53	`cfg_select!` macro (tracking issue
54	[rust-lang/rust#115585](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/115585)),
55	which `rustc 1.92.0` stable rejects with `E0658` before any workspace code
56	compiles — confirmed independent of this plan's changes via a clean
57	`cargo check -p sea-forge-capability` on the unmodified `0.40` pin. No
58	`libsqlite3-sys` patch fixes this (`0.38.1` is current; `cargo info` confirms
59	no newer release exists as of this check). `rusqlite = "0.32.1"` resolves to
60	`libsqlite3-sys = "0.30.1"`, which does **not** use `cfg_select!` and builds
61	cleanly; its `build.rs` still passes `-DSQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5` unconditionally
62	under `bundled` (confirmed by reading `libsqlite3-sys-0.30.1/build.rs`), so
63	FTS5 availability is unaffected. This is a version-pin downgrade to the same
64	approved crate/mechanism (`rusqlite`, `bundled`), not a technology
65	substitution — `deny.toml` license allowances (`MIT`) are unaffected. Revisit
66	`0.40` once `cfg_select` stabilizes or a `libsqlite3-sys` patch avoids it.
67	
68	- Confirmed current release: `0.40.1` (crates.io `max_version`/`newest_version`
69	  as of 2026-07-22; wrapper crate license `MIT`).
70	- `bundled` compiles `libsqlite3-sys`'s vendored SQLite 3.x from source via
71	  the `cc` crate rather than linking the host's system SQLite, giving a
72	  deterministic build across dev machines and CI regardless of host OS
73	  SQLite version.
74	- **FTS5 requires no separate rusqlite-level feature.** Confirmed directly
75	  from `libsqlite3-sys`'s `build.rs` (`build_bundled` function): the bundled
76	  compile always passes `-DSQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5` (alongside `FTS3`, `RTREE`,
77	  `JSON1`) unconditionally when `bundled` is enabled. Rusqlite itself has no
78	  `fts5` cargo feature — FTS5 tables are created and queried with plain SQL
79	  (`CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE ... USING fts5(...)`) once the underlying library
80	  supports it.
81	- Vendored SQLite C source is public domain and carries no separate SPDX
82	  license entry (it is not a distinct crates.io dependency); no `deny.toml`
83	  license-allow-list change is required.
84	- Alternative considered and rejected: system-linked SQLite (default
85	  features, no `bundled`). Rejected because FTS5 availability would then
86	  depend on how the host distribution compiled its SQLite package — not
87	  guaranteed on every dev machine or CI image, and it would reintroduce the
88	  "silent capability drift across environments" problem Task 7 exists to
89	  eliminate.
90	
91	### 2. `landlock` upgrade for M1 jail network denial
92	
93	Change `crates/sea-forge-sandbox/Cargo.toml`:
94	
95	```toml
96	[target.'cfg(target_os = "linux")'.dependencies]
97	landlock = "0.4"
98	```
99	
100	- Confirmed current release: `0.4.5` (crates.io `max_version` as of
101	  2026-07-22; license `MIT OR Apache-2.0`, already allowed).
102	- `landlock` `0.3.x` predates `AccessNet` entirely (added in the ABI V4
103	  network-restriction release). `0.4` adds
104	  `AccessNet::{BindTcp, ConnectTcp}`, `NetPort` rules, and the
105	  `ABI::V4`/`V5`/`V6` variants, confirmed from the crate's own `compat.rs`
106	  source (V4 = Linux 6.7 network, V5 = Linux 6.10 ioctl, V6 = Linux 6.12
107	  scoped signals/abstract-unix-sockets).
108	- `jail.rs` currently hardcodes `let abi = ABI::V1;` twice (lines 42, 275).
109	  Task 3 replaces this with negotiated compatibility (the crate's
110	  `Compatible`/`RulesetAttr` pattern, e.g. `ABI::V4` requested with graceful
111	  degradation on older kernels), not a second hardcoded constant.
112	- **Network scope is TCP-only, and this matches the spec as written.**
113	  Landlock has never had UDP or raw-socket coverage in any ABI version
114	  through V6 (confirmed: `AccessNet` only defines `BindTcp`/`ConnectTcp`).
115	  `spec-full.md:1434` already scopes the requirement to exactly this: *"no
116	  network unless the rule grants `network: true` (default false; Landlock
117	  v4+ TCP restrictions where available, else document the gap on macOS)."*
118	  Task 3 therefore enforces TCP bind/connect denial by default and documents
119	  the UDP/raw-socket gap explicitly (in code comments and the M1 conformance
120	  suite) rather than inventing a broader mechanism the spec does not ask for.
121	- **No new dependency for network-namespace isolation.** A `nix`-based
122	  `unshare(CLONE_NEWNET)` approach was considered for full-protocol coverage
123	  but rejected for this plan: it is not what the spec requires, it adds a new
124	  direct dependency plus a privileged-operation portability question
125	  (unprivileged user/network namespaces are not universally available), and
126	  it would need its own explicit-grant proxy design that is out of scope.
127	  Revisit only if a future spec revision requires UDP/raw coverage.
128	- **macOS**: `crates/sea-forge-sandbox/src/jail.rs` has no Seatbelt branch
129	  today — `JailSandbox::new()`, `execute()`, and the interactive path all
130	  return `unsupported_sandbox_class_error` unconditionally off Linux. This
131	  matches `spec-full.md`'s own acceptance criteria verbatim ("Jail probe on a
132	  host without Landlock → fails preflight with `unsupported_sandbox_class_error`;
133	  nothing runs" and "Seatbelt cases on Linux CI MUST report as skipped, not
134	  passed"). Task 3 does not need to implement Seatbelt; it must not regress
135	  this already-correct fail-closed behavior.
136	
137	### 3. `chacha20poly1305` for the M13 sealed summarized-mode transcript
138	
139	Add to `crates/sea-forge-server/Cargo.toml` (the crate that owns
140	`case_dispatch.rs`/retention resolution per Task 16):
141	
142	```toml
143	chacha20poly1305 = { version = "0.11", features = ["zeroize"] }
144	```
145	
146	- Confirmed current release: `0.11.0` (crates.io `max_version` as of
147	  2026-07-22; license `Apache-2.0 OR MIT`, already allowed). Published by the
148	  RustCrypto `AEADs` project; pure Rust, `no_std`-capable, with optional
149	  architecture-specific acceleration — no `unsafe` in the consuming crate
150	  (workspace-wide `unsafe_code = "deny"` lint is unaffected).
151	- The crate ships **XChaCha20Poly1305** in the same package (confirmed via
152	  crates.io keywords `xchacha20`, `xchacha20poly1305`), which uses a 192-bit
153	  random nonce — safe to generate per-seal with the existing `rand`/
154	  `getrandom` workspace dependencies without a nonce-reuse counter to manage.
155	- `features = ["zeroize"]` wires the crate's key material to the workspace's
156	  existing `zeroize` dependency (already used in `sea-forge-agent` for
157	  credential handling), zeroizing the in-memory key after use.
158	- **Design**: generate one random 256-bit key per delegation run at seal
159	  time; store it at `.sea-forge/sealed/<run_id>.key` (mode `0600`) — a path
160	  outside the public `full`-mode artifact surface (`artifacts/` and
161	  `runs/<run_id>/` evidence). Seal the Task 2 canonical redacted transcript
162	  bytes with `XChaCha20Poly1305`; store the ciphertext next to the run's
163	  other evidence (its own confidentiality comes from the key file, not from
164	  its storage location, so it does not need special placement). Verify the
165	  AEAD tag by decrypting immediately after sealing, before settlement
166	  completes (Task 16 step 4's "verify before completion"). Crypto-shredding
167	  is deleting `.sea-forge/sealed/<run_id>.key`; without it, the ciphertext is
168	  permanently unrecoverable while `transcript_sha256` and `summary` (per
169	  `spec-agent-orchestration.md:190-194`) remain independently verifiable.
170	- Alternative considered: `aes-gcm` (same RustCrypto family, same license,
171	  hardware-accelerated via AES-NI on capable CPUs but slower without it — a
172	  pure-portability tradeoff, not a security one; `chacha20poly1305` was
173	  preferred for uniform performance across dev/CI/production without an
174	  AES-NI dependency).
175	- Alternative considered and rejected: the `age` crate / existing
176	  SOPS+age operator-secrets infrastructure (`justfile` `secrets-*` recipes,
177	  `.sops.yaml`). Rejected because `age` is designed around long-lived
178	  recipient keypairs for human-operated file encryption; reusing the
179	  operator's single age identity as the transcript-sealing key would mean
180	  crypto-shredding one run's transcript requires destroying the key for
181	  *every* sealed transcript across the whole installation, which defeats the
182	  per-run crypto-shredding semantics the spec requires.
183	- Alternative considered and rejected: `ring` (already present transitively
184	  via `reqwest`'s `rustls-tls` feature). Rejected in favor of the
185	  RustCrypto family for a less C/BoringSSL-derived dependency footprint and
186	  a simpler license story under `deny.toml`.
187	
188	## Alternatives Considered
189	
190	See the per-dependency "Alternative considered" notes above; each dependency
191	had one narrower/rejected option, not a separate section, because the
192	tradeoffs are local to that dependency rather than to the plan as a whole.
193	
194	## Consequences
195	
196	- Three new/upgraded direct dependencies: `rusqlite` (new, `sea-forge-capability`
197	  only), `landlock` (upgraded in place, `sea-forge-sandbox` only, Linux-only
198	  target dependency), `chacha20poly1305` (new, `sea-forge-server` only).
199	  None touch a kernel crate covered by `just no-async-kernel`— `rusqlite` and
200	  `chacha20poly1305` are synchronous libraries, `landlock` was already a
201	  sandbox-only dependency.
202	- `cargo deny check licenses` requires no `deny.toml` changes: `MIT`,
203	  `Apache-2.0`, and `MIT OR Apache-2.0`/`Apache-2.0 OR MIT` are already
204	  allowed.
205	- `landlock` 0.3→0.4 is a breaking API change for `jail.rs` (new `Compatible`
206	  trait shape, `AccessNet` addition); Task 3 owns that rewrite. This ADR only
207	  approves the version/feature choice.
208	- The sealed-transcript key-file path (`.sea-forge/sealed/<run_id>.key`) is a
209	  new persisted artifact location; Task 16 must add it to whatever inventory
210	  enumerates `.sea-forge/**` runtime output and must never commit it (per the
211	  plan's guardrail against committing `.sea-forge/**`).
212	- None of these three choices requires a `Cargo.lock` change beyond the
213	  ordinary `cargo fetch`/`cargo build` refresh each owning task performs when
214	  it lands its dependency addition; Task 0 does not modify `Cargo.toml`
215	  itself, only records the approved exact choice.

# ADR-003: Public/persisted contract deltas for the four-spec audit remediation plan

## Status

Accepted

## Date

2026-07-22

## Context

`.agents/plans/2026-07-22-spec-audit-remediation.md` Task 0 requires an
inventory of additive policy/config/public-type changes needed by Tasks 1-18,
and owner approval of the compatibility approach before any task lands code.
The plan's guardrails forbid altering persisted schemas, policy precedence, ID
grammar, exit codes, or public interfaces without explicit approval — this ADR
is that approval, scoped to *additive* deltas only.

Before drafting the inventory, the repository was checked field-by-field
rather than assumed, because several items the plan's per-task steps describe
as needing new fields already exist from prior milestone work (M9-M16 landed
between this plan's audit and today per `git log`):

- `Operation::AgentTask` (`crates/sea-forge-core/src/types.rs:161-171`)
  **already carries** `response_schema: Option<serde_json::Value>` and
  `transcript_retention: Option<String>`. Tasks 15/16's defect is that
  `case_dispatch.rs` currently *drops* these fields on the floor, not that the
  fields are missing. **No new persisted field is needed for these two.**
- `PolicyRule.memory_scope: Option<String>` (`crates/sea-forge-authority/src/lib.rs:738`)
  **already exists**. Task 6's defect is that generic reserved-authority
  matching ignores it, not that it is absent. **No new field needed.**
- `OriginRefKind::DesiredOutcome`, `ItemKind::AgentTask`,
  `ManagerIteration` (with `case_id`/`iteration`/`snapshot_*`/`judgment`
  fields) and the M9 `ProjectionKind` self-model variants are **already
  landed and versioned** (see the in-code compatibility comments at
  `types.rs:659-663` and `:1199-1202`). These are cross-referenced, not
  re-approved, by this ADR.

This matters because it shrinks the genuinely new surface this ADR must
approve, and it establishes the compatibility convention already in
production use, which the remaining genuinely-new deltas below follow rather
than invent.

## Established compatibility convention (already in production, not new)

Confirmed from four live precedents in `sea-forge-core::types`:

1. **New optional struct field**: `#[serde(default)]` +
   `Option<T>` (+ `skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none"` when the type
   should omit the field entirely on old-shape output). Old readers that
   don't know the field simply never populate it; new readers treat absence
   as "not set." Precedent: `PolicyRule.memory_scope`,
   `Operation::AgentTask.{response_schema,transcript_retention}`.
2. **New enum variant, old readers structurally never see it**: append the
   variant; document (in a doc-comment on the variant) which record_kind or
   context gates its appearance so an old binary never deserializes a record
   that could contain it. Precedent: `ProjectionKind`'s M9 self-model
   variants (gated on `record_kind == self_model_projection` /
   `.sea-forge/self-model/`).
3. **New enum variant, old readers may see it and must fail clean**: append
   the variant and accept that an old reader's `serde` deserialization
   returns `Err` (not a panic, not silent data loss) because the variant only
   appears in records a new-only code path produces. Precedent:
   `OriginRefKind::DesiredOutcome`.
4. **No version bump for additive changes**: `RECORD_VERSION`/schema-tag
   values only change for a genuinely breaking shape change; purely additive
   deltas reuse the existing version and rely on (1)-(3) instead.

Every genuinely new delta below is approved under one of these three shapes,
not a fourth pattern.

## Decision — genuinely new deltas by task

- **Task 5 (DomainForge source-set boundary, M0)**: new finite-limits +
  pinned-version fields on the adapter's source-set contract in
  `crates/sea-forge-domainforge/src/lib.rs` (not `sea-forge-core`, per
  ADR-001's boundary) — shape (1), additive `Option`/defaulted fields on a
  contract that is itself new-ish and not yet widely persisted across old
  records. `source_refs`/model identity gain these as required inputs to
  hashing, per the spec's stable-identity requirement.
- **Task 6 (memory authority scope, M4b)**: no new field (see Context above).
  Behavior-only: `crates/sea-forge-authority/src/lib.rs` must match
  `PolicyRule.memory_scope` against the exact requested target
  entity/process instead of ignoring it, and the canonical `recall_memory`
  action must include target scope so the decision hash changes when scope
  changes. This is an enforcement fix, not a contract delta, and needed no
  owner sign-off under the "no persisted schema change" guardrail — recorded
  here only so Task 6 is not blocked waiting for an ADR entry that isn't
  required.
- **Task 9 (spec-pipeline prerequisites, M5 library)**: shape (1) additive
  fields on the stage/input contract naming immutable predecessor records
  (status, hash, schema, DomainModelRef, pinned DomainForge version) plus
  validation evidence refs. **Owner note (corrected):** `schema_ref`,
  `domain_model_ref`, and `domainforge_version` are owned by
  `sea-forge-core::types::StageFile`, NOT by `sea-forge-spec-pipeline — the
  landed core `StageFile` fields already provide the compatibility path Task
  9 needs, so no future core addition is required for this contract. Task 9
  step 2 keeps a small order helper if the addition can be avoided; this ADR
  pre-approves the addition only for fields not already on core `StageFile`.
- **Task 10A (M5 stage CasePlan, M5 runner)**: shape (1)/(2) — the smallest
  typed stage operation/metadata addition to `sea-forge-core::types`, added
  *only if* existing `Operation`/`ItemKind`/`StageFile` vocabulary cannot
  carry Task 9's predecessor refs (Task 10A step 2 explicitly prefers reuse
  first; the core `StageFile` fields above are the primary reuse target).
- **Task 11 (self-model realization, M9)**: no new record types — the M9
  `ProjectionKind` self-model variants and snapshot/projection shapes already
  exist (see Context). The delta is behavior-only: populate the
  already-defined governance refs (authority/evidence/settlement) instead of
  leaving them empty, per the "Key facts" table.
- **Task 12 (ODI provenance, M10)**: no new persisted type — replaces
  `sha256:placeholder`/`outcome:primary` literal values in
  `crates/sea-forge-planner/src/templates.rs` with real resolved values in
  the *existing* `OriginRefKind::DesiredOutcome`-shaped fields. Behavior-only.
- **Task 13/13B (Thoth claims, M11)**: shape (1) — `authored_by` on
  Thoth-constructed claims (already-current claim record gains an immutable
  actor-identity field, included in canonical claim hashing per Task 13B step
  2). The shared SoD predicate moves to
  `sea_forge_core::types::validate_claim_authorship_sod` (a new *public
  function*, not a persisted-schema change — approved as the "smallest shared
  typed helper" the plan's redesign trigger anticipates).
- **Task 14A/14B (Thoth service + adapters, M11)**: shape (1) — a new `ask`
  `Request` variant on `crates/sea-forge-server/src/lib.rs`'s `Request` enum
  (`enum Request { Submit, Status, Approve, ... }`, confirmed
  `#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]` tagged enum at `lib.rs:393-405`).
  Task 14B step 4 explicitly requires "version-skew/protocol tests for
  clients that do not understand the new request variant" — shape (3): an
  old server rejects/`serde` errors on the new tag cleanly rather than
  panicking; a new client talking to an old server gets a typed protocol
  error, never a silent misroute.
- **Task 15 (delegation schema/termination, M13)**: no new field (see
  Context: `response_schema`/`transcript_retention` already exist on
  `Operation::AgentTask`). Behavior-only: carry the existing fields through
  `DelegationRequest`/`case_dispatch.rs` instead of dropping them, and return
  the real committed `SettlementEvent` instead of constructing a synthetic
  `basis: ["delegation_completed"]`.
- **Task 16 (retention/sealed storage, M13)**: shape (1) — retention
  fields/defaults added to `crates/sea-forge-agent/src/config.rs`, server
  config, and the delegation request struct (distinct from the per-task-item
  `Operation::AgentTask.transcript_retention` override, which already
  exists) — these are the *endpoint/global/default* precedence levels the
  spec's resolution order requires, with "explicit version-skew tests" per
  Task 16 step 1. New non-schema artifact: the sealed-transcript key file at
  `.sea-forge/sealed/<run_id>.key` (ADR-002) — a filesystem-path addition,
  not a serialized-record-shape addition, so it needs no version tag, only
  an entry in whatever documentation enumerates `.sea-forge/**` runtime
  paths.
- **Task 17 (endpoint/manager caps, M14/M15)**: shape (1) — a validated
  endpoint parameter/default-resolution contract added to topology templates
  and the manager catalog (replacing the invalid `agent:builtin`/
  `agent:default` placeholder IDs), and binding requested
  `max_manager_iterations` into the canonical manager authority action/
  decision (the existing `ManagerIteration` record shape at
  `types.rs:829-844` is unchanged; the cap becomes an *authority-action*
  input, not a new field on the iteration record itself).
- **Task 18 (SWE_SEED reconciliation, M16)**: no new persisted record type —
  `submit_swe_seed_declaration` and the reconciliation module are new
  *functions/services* over existing `SweSeedTransport`/settlement-
  declaration shapes (per Task 18 step 2's explicit reuse of
  `append_declaration_ledgered_once`). The materialized
  `runs/<run_id>/swe-seed-correlation.json` view is a new *derived,
  rebuildable* file, not a new source-of-truth schema.

## Alternatives Considered

### Bump `RECORD_VERSION` (or an equivalent global schema version) for this plan

Rejected. Every genuinely new delta above is additive under the
already-established compatibility conventions (1)-(3); none removes,
renames, or changes the meaning of an existing field or variant. A version

314	        vec![
315	            intent_ref.entry_ulid().into(),
316	            criteria_ref.entry_ulid().into(),
317	        ],
318	    )?;
319	
320	    let action = action_for_delegation(
321	        &snapshot,
322	        endpoint_id,
323	        &model,
324	        &instruction_hash,
325	        request.max_turns,
326	        request.token_budget,
327	    );
328	    let policy = resolve_policy_path(&config.root, request.policy_path);
329	    let bundle = AuthorityPolicyBundle::load(&policy)?;
330	    let engine = PolicyAuthorityEngine::new(bundle.clone())?;
331	    let actor = Actor {
332	        actor_id: request.entity.into(),
333	        role: ActorRole::Operator,
334	    };
335	    let binding = bundle.resolve_identity(&actor.actor_id, actor.role.clone());
336	    let decision = engine.evaluate(AuthorityEvaluation {
337	        actor: &actor,
338	        binding,
339	        run_id: run,
340	        case_id: case,
341	        plan_item_id: item,
342	        sequence: 1,
343	        action: &action,
344	        workspace_root: &config.root,
345	        evidence_refs: vec![
346	            intent_ref.entry_ulid().into(),
347	            criteria_ref.entry_ulid().into(),
348	            plan_ref.entry_ulid().into(),
349	        ],
350	        artifacts_root: None,
351	        timeout_secs: Some(snapshot.timeout.as_secs()),
352	        env_keys: Default::default(),
353	        domainforge_candidate: None,
354	        environment: None,
355	    })?;
356	    let decision_ref = commit_view(
357	        &ledger,
358	        "authority_decision",
359	        vec![run.into(), item.into()],
360	        &decision,
361	        &config.root.join("runs").join(run).join("authority.json"),
362	        vec![
363	            intent_ref.entry_ulid().into(),
364	            criteria_ref.entry_ulid().into(),
365	            plan_ref.entry_ulid().into(),
366	        ],
367	    )?;
368	
369	    if decision.verdict != Verdict::Allow {
370	        return finish_rejected(
371	            &ledger,
372	            &config.root,
373	            case,
374	            item,
375	            run,
376	            endpoint_id,
377	            decision_ref.entry_ulid(),
378	            "authority_denied",
379	        );
380	    }
381	    let grant = engine.grant(&decision, &decision_ref, &action, None)?;
382	    let sandbox_class = grant.sandbox_class().to_string();
383	    grant.authorize(&action, run, item, &config.root)?;
384	
385	    // Provider dispatch. ACP is a child-process executor with no ambient
386	    // credential; HTTP kinds resolve a credential via secret_access first.
387	    let mut continuation_key: Option<String> = None;
388	    let mut harvested_refs: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
389	    let outcome: sea_forge_agent::DelegationOutcome = if snapshot.kind == ProviderKind::Acp {
390	        let (out, cont, harvested) = run_acp_episode(
391	            &config.root,
392	            &snapshot,
393	            &bundle,
394	            request.entity,
395	            request.process,
396	            run,
397	            case,
398	            item,
399	            instruction,
400	            request.max_turns,
401	            cancel,
402	            permission_broker,
403	            criteria.clone(),
404	            criteria_ref.clone(),
405	            &sandbox_class,
406	        )
407	        .await?;
408	        continuation_key = cont;
409	        harvested_refs = harvested;
410	        out
411	    } else {
412	        // Credential resolution via secret_access (HTTP only). A denial
413	        // commits rejection evidence + settlement and short-circuits, exactly
414	        // as in M13 — no provider call, no secret read.
415	        let credential = match snapshot.credential_ref.as_deref() {
416	            Some(reference) => {
417	                let secret_action = AuthorityAction::Reserved {
418	                    resource_type: "secret_access".into(),
419	                    resource_id: reference.into(),
420	                    parameters: json!({"credential_ref": reference}),
421	                };
422	                let secret_binding = bundle.resolve_identity(&actor.actor_id, actor.role.clone());
423	                let secret_decision = engine.evaluate(AuthorityEvaluation {
424	                    actor: &actor,
425	                    binding: secret_binding,
426	                    run_id: run,
427	                    case_id: case,
428	                    plan_item_id: item,
429	                    sequence: 2,
430	                    action: &secret_action,
431	                    workspace_root: &config.root,
432	                    evidence_refs: vec![decision_ref.entry_ulid().into()],
433	                    artifacts_root: None,
434	                    timeout_secs: Some(snapshot.timeout.as_secs()),
435	                    env_keys: Default::default(),
436	                    domainforge_candidate: None,
437	                    environment: None,
438	                })?;
439	                let secret_ledger =
440	                    LedgerStream::open(&config.root, format!("case-{case}"), "sea-forge-agent")?;
441	                let secret_ref = commit_view(
442	                    &secret_ledger,
443	                    "authority_decision",
444	                    vec![run.into(), item.into(), "secret_access".into()],
445	                    &secret_decision,
446	                    &config
447	                        .root
448	                        .join("runs")
449	                        .join(run)
450	                        .join("secret-authority.json"),
451	                    vec![decision_ref.entry_ulid().into()],
452	                )?;
453	                if secret_decision.verdict != Verdict::Allow {
454	                    return finish_rejected(
455	                        &secret_ledger,
456	                        &config.root,
457	                        case,
458	                        item,
459	                        run,
460	                        endpoint_id,
461	                        secret_ref.entry_ulid(),
462	                        "secret_access_denied",
463	                    );
464	                }
465	                let secret_grant =
466	                    engine.grant(&secret_decision, &secret_ref, &secret_action, None)?;
467	                secret_grant.authorize(&secret_action, run, item, &config.root)?;
468	                resolver.resolve(reference)?
469	            }
470	            None => Zeroizing::new(String::new()),
471	        };
472	        run_http_episode(
473	            &config.root,
474	            &snapshot,
475	            credential,
476	            run,
477	            case,
478	            item,
479	            instruction,
480	            request.max_turns,
481	            request.token_budget,
482	            cancel,
483	            model.clone(),
484	        )
485	        .await?
486	    };
487	
488	    // Persist the redacted canonical transcript artifact in full mode.
489	    // ponytail: only full retention is supported; summarized mode is
490	    // intentionally not implemented because digest recomputation is not
491	    // independently verifiable (spec §7.4).
492	    let artifact_ref = if outcome.transcript.is_empty() {
493	        None
494	    } else {
495	        // Single producer: re-run the shared redactor/canonicalizer over the
496	        // (already-redacted) entries so the artifact bytes are the EXACT bytes
497	        // the digest commits to. `produce_transcript` is idempotent on
498	        // pre-redacted input; the sentinel corpus is applied once more as
499	        // defense in depth. This replaces the old divergent per-entry
500	        // `serde_json::to_string` serialization for both HTTP and ACP.
501	        let produced = sea_forge_agent::produce_transcript(&outcome.transcript, &[]);
502	        debug_assert_eq!(
503	            produced.sha256, outcome.transcript_sha256,
504	            "artifact bytes diverge from committed transcript digest"
505	        );
506	        let hex = outcome
507	            .transcript_sha256
508	            .strip_prefix("sha256:")
509	            .unwrap_or(&outcome.transcript_sha256);
510	        let artifact_path = config
511	            .root
512	            .join("runs")
513	            .join(run)
514	            .join(format!("transcript-{hex}.jsonl"));
515	        std::fs::create_dir_all(artifact_path.parent().unwrap())
516	            .map_err(|e| ForgeError::io("create transcript artifact parent", e))?;
517	        std::fs::write(&artifact_path, &produced.canonical_bytes)
518	            .map_err(|e| ForgeError::io("write transcript artifact", e))?;
519	        Some(
520	            artifact_path
521	                .strip_prefix(&config.root)
522	                .map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
523	                .unwrap_or_else(|_| format!("runs/{run}/transcript-{hex}.jsonl")),
524	        )
525	    };
526	
527	    // Record transcript evidence and settle.
528	    let evidence = TranscriptEvidence {
529	        run_id: run.into(),
530	        endpoint_ref: endpoint_id.into(),
531	        turns_used: outcome.turns_used,
532	        termination: outcome.termination.clone(),
533	        transcript_sha256: outcome.transcript_sha256.clone(),
534	        summary: outcome.summary.clone(),
535	        artifact_ref: artifact_ref.clone(),
536	        harvested_refs,
537	    };
538	    let mut evidence_parents = vec![decision_ref.entry_ulid().into()];
539	    if let Some(key) = continuation_key.as_deref() {
540	        let session_ref = commit_view(
541	            &ledger,
542	            "acp_session",
543	            vec![case.into(), run.into(), item.into()],
544	            &AcpSessionRecord {
545	                version: "0.2",
546	                case_id: case,
547	                run_id: run,
548	                plan_item_id: item,
549	                endpoint_ref: endpoint_id,
550	                continuation_key: key,
551	                protocol_version: sea_forge_agent::ACP_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
552	            },
553	            &config.root.join("runs").join(run).join("acp-session.json"),
554	            vec![decision_ref.entry_ulid().into()],
555	        )?;
556	        evidence_parents.push(session_ref.entry_ulid().into());
557	    }
558	    let evidence_ref = commit_view(
559	        &ledger,
560	        "agent_task_evidence",
561	        vec![case.into(), run.into(), item.into()],
562	        &DelegationTranscriptEvidence {
563	            evidence: &evidence,
564	            case_id: case,
565	            item_id: item,
566	        },
567	        &config
568	            .root
569	            .join("runs")
570	            .join(run)
571	            .join("transcript-evidence.json"),
572	        evidence_parents,
573	    )?;
574	    let settlement_parents = if evidence.harvested_refs.is_empty() {
575	        vec![evidence_ref.entry_ulid().into()]
576	    } else {
577	        let declaration_ids = swe_seed_declarations_for_run(&config.root, run)?;
578	        let correlation_ref = commit_view(
579	            &ledger,
580	            "swe_seed_correlation",
581	            vec![case.into(), run.into(), item.into()],
582	            &SweSeedCorrelation {
583	                version: "0.2",
584	                case_id: case,
585	                run_id: run,
586	                plan_item_id: item,
587	                harvested_refs: &evidence.harvested_refs,
588	                declaration_ids,
589	            },
590	            &config
591	                .root
592	                .join("runs")
593	                .join(run)
594	                .join("swe-seed-correlation.json"),
595	            vec![evidence_ref.entry_ulid().into()],
596	        )?;
597	        vec![correlation_ref.entry_ulid().into()]
598	    };
599	
600	    let (status, basis, criteria_error) = match outcome.termination {
601	        DelegationTermination::Completed => match sea_forge_settlement::evaluate_agent_output(
602	            outcome.final_output.as_deref().unwrap_or_default(),
603	            request.criteria.agent_output_must_contain.as_deref(),
604	        ) {
605	            Some(false) => (
606	                SettlementStatus::Rejected,
607	                vec!["authority_allow".into(), "agent_output_mismatch".into()],
608	                Some("agent_output_mismatch".into()),
609	            ),
610	            _ => (
611	                SettlementStatus::Accepted,
612	                vec!["authority_allow".into(), "delegation_completed".into()],
613	                None,
614	            ),
615	        },
616	        DelegationTermination::TurnCapExceeded => (
617	            SettlementStatus::Rejected,
618	            vec!["turn_cap_exceeded".into()],
619	            None,
620	        ),
621	        DelegationTermination::Cancelled => {
622	            (SettlementStatus::Rejected, vec!["cancelled".into()], None)
623	        }
624	        DelegationTermination::EndpointError => (
625	            SettlementStatus::Rejected,
626	            vec!["agent_endpoint_error".into()],
627	            None,
628	        ),
629	        DelegationTermination::AcpDisconnect => (
630	            SettlementStatus::Rejected,
631	            vec!["acp_disconnect".into()],
632	            None,
633	        ),
634	    };
635	
636	    let settlement = SettlementEvent {
637	        version: "0.2".into(),
638	        settlement_id: random_id("set")?,
639	        run_id: run.into(),
640	        status: status.clone(),
641	        basis,
642	        review_required: false,
643	        settled_at: Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
644	        criteria_ref: None,
645	    };
646	    commit_view(
647	        &ledger,
648	        "settlement",
649	        vec![run.into(), item.into()],
650	        &DelegationSettlement {
651	            settlement: &settlement,
652	            case_id: case,
653	            item_id: item,
654	        },
655	        &config.root.join("runs").join(run).join("settlement.json"),
656	        settlement_parents,
657	    )?;
658	
659	    Ok(DelegationResult {
660	        endpoint: endpoint_id.into(),
661	        run_id: run.into(),
662	        settlement: status,
663	        termination: Some(termination_str(&outcome.termination)),
664	        transcript_sha256: Some(outcome.transcript_sha256),
665	        turns_used: outcome.turns_used,
666	        error_class: criteria_error.or(outcome.error_subcode),
667	        continuation_key,
668	    })
669	}

671	fn swe_seed_declarations_for_run(root: &Path, run: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, ForgeError> {
672	    let primary = root.join("declarations.jsonl");
673	    let fallback = root.join("settlement").join("declarations.jsonl");
674	    let path = if primary.exists() { primary } else { fallback };
675	    let declarations = sea_forge_settlement::load_declarations(&path)?;
676	    Ok(declarations
677	        .into_iter()
678	        .filter(|declaration| declaration.run_id == run)
679	        .filter(|declaration| declaration.verifier_ref.contains("swe_seed"))
680	        .map(|declaration| declaration.declaration_id)
681	        .collect())
682	}

684	fn termination_str(t: &DelegationTermination) -> String {
685	    match t {
686	        DelegationTermination::Completed => "completed",
687	        DelegationTermination::TurnCapExceeded => "turn_cap_exceeded",
688	        DelegationTermination::Cancelled => "cancelled",
689	        DelegationTermination::EndpointError => "endpoint_error",
690	        DelegationTermination::AcpDisconnect => "acp_disconnect",
691	    }
692	    .into()
693	}

791	/// HTTP-provider episode: run the delegation loop against a resolved
792	/// credential. Credential resolution + `secret_access` authority stays in
793	/// `execute_with_control` so the denial short-circuit (`finish_rejected`)
794	/// preserves M13 behavior exactly.
795	#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
796	async fn run_http_episode(
797	    root: &Path,
798	    snapshot: &sea_forge_agent::EndpointSnapshot,
799	    credential: Zeroizing<String>,
800	    run: &str,
801	    case: &str,
802	    item: &str,
803	    instruction: &str,
804	    max_turns: u32,
805	    token_budget: Option<u64>,
806	    cancel: impl Fn() -> bool + Send + Sync + 'static,
807	    model: String,
808	) -> Result<sea_forge_agent::DelegationOutcome, ForgeError> {
809	    let _ = (root, run, case, item);
810	    let delegation_config = DelegationConfig {
811	        model,
812	        instruction: instruction.into(),
813	        max_turns,
814	        token_budget,
815	        max_output_tokens: Some(snapshot.max_response_bytes.min(4096) as u32),
816	    };
817	    let outcome = match &snapshot.kind {
818	        ProviderKind::OpenAiCompatible => {
819	            let provider = OpenAiCompatibleProvider::new(snapshot.clone()).map_err(|message| {
820	                ForgeError::Config {
821	                    class: "agent_endpoint_error",
822	                    path: root.join("server.yaml"),
823	                    message,
824	                }
825	            })?;
826	            run_delegation(&provider, credential, &delegation_config, cancel)
827	                .await
828	                .map_err(|e| ForgeError::Internal(e.to_string()))?
829	        }
830	        ProviderKind::Anthropic => {
831	            let provider =
832	                AnthropicProvider::new(snapshot.clone()).map_err(|message| ForgeError::Config {
833	                    class: "agent_endpoint_error",
834	                    path: root.join("server.yaml"),
835	                    message,
836	                })?;
837	            run_delegation(&provider, credential, &delegation_config, cancel)
838	                .await
839	                .map_err(|e| ForgeError::Internal(e.to_string()))?
840	        }
841	        ProviderKind::Acp => {
842	            return Err(ForgeError::Internal(
843	                "ACP dispatched through HTTP episode path".into(),
844	            ));
845	        }
846	    };
847	    Ok(outcome)
848	}

850	/// ACP episode: spawn the CLI agent under the run grant and drive one
851	/// delegation through the ACP driver. No credential, no ambient environment
852	/// (spec §10.4, §15). Every `session/request_permission` is mediated into a
853	/// durable `permission_request` record + authority decision.
854	#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
855	async fn run_acp_episode(
856	    root: &Path,
857	    snapshot: &sea_forge_agent::EndpointSnapshot,
858	    bundle: &AuthorityPolicyBundle,
859	    entity: &str,
860	    process: &str,
861	    run: &str,
862	    case: &str,
863	    item: &str,
864	    instruction: &str,
865	    max_turns: u32,
866	    cancel: impl Fn() -> bool + Send + Sync + 'static,
867	    permission_broker: Option<AcpApprovalBroker>,
868	    criteria: sea_forge_core::types::SettlementCriteriaRecord,
869	    criteria_ref: sea_forge_ledger::CommittedRecordRef,
870	    sandbox_class: &str,
871	) -> Result<
872	    (
873	        sea_forge_agent::DelegationOutcome,
874	        Option<String>,
875	        Vec<String>,
876	    ),
877	    ForgeError,
878	> {
879	    let argv: Vec<String> = snapshot.argv.clone();
880	    if argv.is_empty() {
881	        return Err(ForgeError::Config {
882	            class: "schema_error",
883	            path: root.join("server.yaml"),
884	            message: "acp endpoint argv is empty".into(),
885	        });
886	    }
887	    let env_pairs: Vec<(String, String)> = snapshot
888	        .env
889	        .iter()
890	        .filter_map(|e| {
891	            e.split_once('=')
892	                .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), v.to_string()))
893	        })
894	        .filter(|(key, _)| !key.starts_with("SEA_FORGE_SWE_SEED_"))
895	        .collect();
896	    let workspace = root.join("runs").join(run).join("workspace");
897	    std::fs::create_dir_all(&workspace).map_err(|e| ForgeError::io("create acp workspace", e))?;
898	    let spawn = AcpSpawn {
899	        argv,
900	        env: env_pairs,
901	        cwd: Some(workspace.clone()),
902	        max_response_bytes: snapshot.max_response_bytes,
903	        max_transcript_bytes: snapshot
904	            .max_request_bytes
905	            .saturating_add(snapshot.max_response_bytes),
906	    };
907	    let session = match sandbox_class {
908	        "local" => AcpSession::spawn(spawn)
909	            .map(|(session, _)| session)
910	            .map_err(|message| ForgeError::Config {
911	                class: "agent_endpoint_error",
912	                path: root.join("server.yaml"),
913	                message,
914	            })?,
915	        "jail" => {
916	            let artifacts = root.join("runs").join(run).join("artifacts");
917	            std::fs::create_dir_all(&artifacts)
918	                .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("create ACP artifacts", error))?;
919	            let workspace_for_jail = workspace.clone();
920	            let argv = spawn.argv.clone();
921	            let env = spawn.env.clone();
922	            let (sender, receiver) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
923	            std::thread::spawn(move || {
924	                // Jail-class ACP agents default to network denial (fail-closed).
925	                // No scoped egress grant is plumbed to this path yet; the jail
926	                // must not open ungranted outbound/listening TCP sockets.

936	            });

938	                .recv()
939	                .map_err(|error| ForgeError::Internal(error.to_string()))??;
940	            AcpSession::from_std_child(
941	                child.child,
942	                child.stdin,
943	                child.stdout,

945	                workspace.clone(),
946	                snapshot.max_response_bytes,

948	                    .max_request_bytes
949	                    .saturating_add(snapshot.max_response_bytes),
950	            )

964	        run_id: run.into(),
965	        item_id: item.into(),
966	        entity: entity.into(),
967	        process: process.into(),
968	        bundle: Arc::new(bundle.clone()),

979	            instruction,
980	            max_turns,
981	            per_turn,
982	            cancel,
983	            &mediator,

995	        }
996	    };

1000	fn harvest_swe_seed(
1001	    snapshot: &sea_forge_agent::EndpointSnapshot,
1002	    workspace: &Path,
1003	    run: &str,
1004	) -> Result<Vec<String>, ForgeError> {
1005	    let configured = |key: &str| {
1006	        snapshot.env.iter().find_map(|entry| {
1007	            entry
1008	                .split_once('=')
1009	                .filter(|(name, _)| *name == key)
1010	                .map(|(_, value)| value.to_string())
1011	        })
1012	    };
1013	    let repo = configured("SEA_FORGE_SWE_SEED_REPO");
1014	    let expected_commit = configured("SEA_FORGE_SWE_SEED_COMMIT");
1015	    match (&repo, &expected_commit) {
1016	        (None, None) => return Ok(Vec::new()),
1017	        (Some(_), Some(_)) => {}
1018	        _ => {
1019	            return Err(ForgeError::Input(
1020	                "SWE_SEED repo and commit must be configured together".into(),
1021	            ));
1022	        }
1023	    }
1024	    let repo = std::fs::canonicalize(repo.unwrap())
1025	        .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("canonicalize SWE_SEED repo", error))?;
1026	    let output = std::process::Command::new("git")
1027	        .args(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
1028	        .current_dir(&repo)
1029	        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
1030	        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
1031	        .output()
1032	        .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("verify SWE_SEED commit", error))?;
1033	    let actual = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
1034	    if !output.status.success() || actual != expected_commit.unwrap() {
1035	        return Err(ForgeError::Input("SWE_SEED commit mismatch".into()));
1036	    }
1037	
1038	    let harness = workspace.join(".agent-harness");
1039	    if !harness.is_dir() {
1040	        return Err(ForgeError::Input(
1041	            "configured SWE_SEED run produced no .agent-harness evidence".into(),
1042	        ));
1043	    }
1044	    let canonical_harness = std::fs::canonicalize(&harness)
1045	        .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("canonicalize SWE_SEED harness", error))?;
1046	    let canonical_workspace = std::fs::canonicalize(workspace)
1047	        .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("canonicalize ACP workspace", error))?;
1048	    let mut pending = vec![harness];
1049	    let mut files = Vec::new();
1050	    while let Some(path) = pending.pop() {
1051	        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&path)
1052	            .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("read SWE_SEED harness", error))?
1053	        {
1054	            let entry = entry.map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("read SWE_SEED entry", error))?;
1055	            let metadata = entry
1056	                .file_type()
1057	                .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("read SWE_SEED entry type", error))?;
1058	            if metadata.is_symlink() {
1059	                return Err(ForgeError::UnsafePath(
1060	                    "SWE_SEED evidence may not contain symlinks".into(),
1061	                ));
1062	            }
1063	            if metadata.is_dir() {
1064	                pending.push(entry.path());
1065	            } else if metadata.is_file() {
1066	                files.push(entry.path());
1067	                if files.len() > 64 {
1068	                    return Err(ForgeError::Input(
1069	                        "SWE_SEED evidence exceeds 64 files".into(),
1070	                    ));
1071	                }
1072	            }
1073	        }
1074	    }
1075	    files.sort();
1076	    let mut refs = Vec::with_capacity(files.len());
1077	    for path in files {
1078	        let canonical = std::fs::canonicalize(&path)
1079	            .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("canonicalize SWE_SEED evidence", error))?;
1080	        if !canonical.starts_with(&canonical_harness) {
1081	            return Err(ForgeError::UnsafePath(
1082	                "SWE_SEED evidence escaped .agent-harness".into(),
1083	            ));
1084	        }
1085	        let bytes = std::fs::read(&canonical)
1086	            .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("read SWE_SEED evidence", error))?;
1087	        if bytes.len() > 1_048_576 {
1088	            return Err(ForgeError::Input(
1089	                "SWE_SEED evidence file exceeds 1 MiB".into(),
1090	            ));
1091	        }
1092	        let relative = canonical
1093	            .strip_prefix(&canonical_workspace)
1094	            .map_err(|_| ForgeError::UnsafePath("invalid SWE_SEED evidence path".into()))?;
1095	        refs.push(format!(
1096	            "{run}:{}:sha256:{:x}",
1097	            relative.to_string_lossy(),
1098	            Sha256::digest(&bytes)
1099	        ));
1100	    }
1101	    Ok(refs)
1102	}
